source.title: Smart Hotel
source.edition_note: No printed edition date verified; 2021-05-14 PDF metadata is not a publication date.
source.folio_basis: 1-based physical PDF pages; each spread is cited by a single PDF folio.

coverage.note: Selective high-level content evidence, not a complete transcription or feature inventory.

usage.rights: No republication grant verified. No source PDF, brochure text, photo, screenshot, logo, contact details or operational procedure included. Keep factual notes attributed; no claim of permission, technical compliance, security, quantified outcomes, or NSP capability.

items.summary_en: The brochure frames hotel automation around a shared view of several building services for operators, alongside a separate guest-facing experience.
items.attribution_limit_en: Editorial framing only. No inference of energy savings, improved loyalty or universal coverage.

items.summary_en: myGEKKO presents its platform as something a hotel can extend in phases instead of digitizing every area at once.
items.attribution_limit_en: Vendor positioning; no assertion that a particular retrofit or interface is supported.

items.summary_en: The brochure distinguishes the way specialists configure the platform from the interface used to operate it, and discusses adapting the latter to the hotel.
items.attribution_limit_en: Describe the audience distinction only; do not reproduce screens or claim configuration requires no expertise.

items.summary_en: A planning spread discusses coordinating building services across suppliers and names a few building automation interface families as examples.
items.attribution_limit_en: Context, not a compatibility matrix, standards verification, installation advice, or implied NSP support.

items.summary_en: myGEKKO illustrates how the view of hotel systems can differ for operators, technicians and maintenance personnel.
items.attribution_limit_en: An information-design idea, not a security evaluation, authorization model recommendation or remote-access procedure.

items.summary_en: The brochure uses an overview to group hotel functions and presents selected status and irregularity information in a central view.
items.attribution_limit_en: Do not copy the dashboard, promise fault resolution or claim all services are monitored.

items.summary_en: The central operations spread mentions linking myGEKKO with guest-management software.
items.attribution_limit_en: No named compatibility, data sharing, integration method, or own-product capability presumed.

items.summary_en: myGEKKO separates guest adjustment of room comfort from the operator’s overview of the rooms.
items.attribution_limit_en: No measurements, automatic action rules, or assumption that NSP implements the same functions.

items.summary_en: The room spread uses occupancy as a way to explain how guest-room comfort relates to lighting, shades and indoor conditions.
items.attribution_limit_en: No trigger logic or energy-saving percentage; not an NSP statement.

items.summary_en: Ambient light and audio sit alongside other wellness-space topics in the brochure’s discussion of guest experience.
items.attribution_limit_en: No treatment, safety, surveillance, water-testing or equipment instructions.

items.summary_en: Kitchen and storage monitoring are treated as distinct hotel operations topics on the application overview and kitchen spreads.
items.attribution_limit_en: Context only; not a food-safety control, HACCP certification, legal advice, or claim about protection from failures.

items.summary_en: The brochure discusses using different lighting atmospheres for different public spaces, including dining, bar and reception areas.
items.attribution_limit_en: Editorial grouping, not installation guidance, performance measurement or an NSP claim.

items.summary_en: The property-edge spread broadens the brochure beyond indoor spaces with examples from parking and landscape management.
items.attribution_limit_en: Context only; no access method, charging or billing mechanism, electrical guidance or capability promised.

items.summary_en: The brochure places its gallery of vendor project examples separately from its general explanation of project coordination.
items.attribution_limit_en: Gallery listings are not NSP references or verified deployments; no service promise or permission for credited images.
